scene_description: Two boys are sliding down a black and white striped water slide into a blue swimming pool. The boy in front wears red striped swim shorts. Both boys have their arms raised and are smiling. Water is splashing around them.

questions.question: Who is on the water slide?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the people coming down the slide.

questions.question: What color are the front boy's swim shorts?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the shorts on the boy in front.

questions.question: Where are the boys sliding into?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the blue water at the bottom of the slide.

questions.question: What colors is the slide?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the stripes on the slide.

questions.question: What are the boys doing with their arms?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the boys' arms in the air.
